bloc.Exception : Fonction d'assistance a l'ed: Exception: A standard editing-assistance function, or the absence of any substantial alteration of the input data.
bloc.Exception : Oeuvre manifestement artisti: Exception: A manifestly artistic, creative, satirical or fictional work: lighter transparency, so as not to spoil the work. For texts: human review or editorial control with editorial responsibility assumed.
bloc.Exception : Sauf si cela est evident au: Exception: Unless this is obvious from the context of use.
bloc.Exception : Usages autorises a des fins: Exception: Uses authorised for the detection or prevention of criminal offences, under the conditions laid down by the Regulation.
bloc.N’impose pas : Aucune mention visible :: Does not impose: Any visible notice: §# is a technical marking, not an on-screen label.
bloc.N’impose pas : Ne concerne aucun contenu: Does not impose: Anything about generated content: it is exposure to the system that triggers the duty to inform.
bloc.N’impose pas : Ne cree aucune obligation: Does not impose: Any new obligation: it governs the form of those in §# to §# that already apply.
bloc.N’impose pas : Ni les contenus internes,: Does not impose: Neither internal content nor deliverables handed to a client: publication to the public, and its subject, are the condition.
bloc.N’impose pas : Rien sur le contenu produ: Does not impose: Anything about the content produced: it is the interaction that is disclosed, not what comes out of it.

texte.A examiner page par page : voir le trois: To be examined page by page: see the third level below, consumer law in particular.
texte.Article ou publication d'actualite gener: An AI-generated news article or publication informing the public
texte.Assistants du site public et Copilote Se: Public-site assistants and the Sentinel Copilot: a notice from the very first interaction, measured on the pages actually served.
No output of this kind to date. Were there any, it would fall under §# and not under a mere internal banner.
texte.Dernier événement Stripe reçu : journal: Last Stripe event received: log not read · checked on #-#-#T#:#:#+#:#
texte.En cas de decision automatisee ou de pro: Where there is automated decision-making or profiling, specific requirements are added.
texte.Exemple : faux avis, faux temoignage, pe: For example: a fake review, a fake testimonial, an artificial character presented as real.
texte.Informer l'utilisateur qu'il interagit a: Inform the user that they are interacting with an AI, unless this is obvious.
texte.L'AI Act ne s'applique pas toujours, mai: The AI Act does not always apply, but other rules may require fair disclosure.
texte.L'article # ne cree pas d'obligation gen: Article # creates no general duty to disclose every internal use of AI.
texte.L'article # ne l'impose pas, en l'absenc: Article # does not require it, absent a deepfake or a text of public interest. The contract, good faith or a client charter may well do so.
texte.La bonne foi contractuelle peut justifie: Contractual good faith may warrant disclosing the use of an AI in certain engagements.
texte.La transparence peut etre adaptee pour n: Transparency may be adapted so as not to spoil the experience of the work.
texte.La transparence porte alors sur le TRAIT: Transparency then bears on the PROCESSING of the data, not only on the generated content.
texte.Le contrat peut imposer d'informer le cl: The contract may require the client to be told that an AI is used.
texte.Les livrables portent une mention visibl: Deliverables carry a visible notice and a machine-readable marking: this is a COMMITMENT of the firm, and it is now written as such in the file properties — no longer « under article # ».
texte.Les politiques fournisseurs et chartes c: Supplier policies and client charters may require it.
texte.Les supports internes ne portent pas de: Internal material carries no marking under §#; it may carry one as a governance choice.
texte.Moyenne Services professionnels, scienti: Average — professional, scientific and technical services
texte.Oeuvre satirique, fiction, creation arti: A satirical work, fiction, artistic creation
texte.Page Actualites : exception de controle: News page: the editorial-control exception is invoked, with an editorial responsibility that is published and named — the exception holds only when documented.
texte.Presentation interne (support de reunion: An internal presentation (meeting deck, working note)
texte.Prestataire qui redige un livrable clien: A provider drafting a client deliverable with the help of an AI
texte.Sans objet : la plateforme ne produit pa: Not applicable: the platform produces no work of fiction.
texte.Si l'outil d'IA traite des donnees perso: If the AI tool processes personal data, the persons concerned must be informed in accordance with the GDPR.
texte.Si le contenu constitue un hypertrucage,: If the content amounts to a deepfake, its artificial nature must be disclosed.
texte.Support commercial, page produit present: Sales material, a product page presenting a service
texte.Transferts hors UE encadres: Transfers outside the EU under safeguards
texte.Transparence requise si le texte est pub: Transparency is required where the text is published to inform the public on a matter of public interest.
texte.Une communication trompeuse sur l'origin: A misleading communication about the origin or nature of an AI may be a problem.
texte.Video publicitaire avec avatar ou voix a: An advertising video with an artificial avatar or voice
